started_at.description: When the signal started firing: the earliest among its firing severities.

signal_labels.description:
Labels of the signal the test notification is for. When the monitor
groups signals by label names, only those names are accepted; when it
uses one signal per series, any name is accepted; when it has no signal
grouping, none are accepted. Names starting with `__chrono_`,
`alertname`, and `severity`, are reserved.

include_previews.description:
Render each recipient's notification preview. Previews cost a render per
integration, so leave this false when only recipient IDs are needed.

signal_labels.description:
Labels of the signal the test notification is for. Same rules as
ListTestNotificationRecipients's `signal_labels`.

recipient_ids.description:
IDs from ListTestNotificationRecipients to deliver to. When empty,
delivers to every recipient the test alert routes to with these signal
labels. An unknown or stale ID fails the request.

TestNotificationRecipientRecipientType.description: - OTHER: A recipient whose integration is not one of the above.

code.description: An optional private error code whose values are undefined.

message.description: An error message describing what went wrong.

datav1Severity.description: The severity an alert fired at.

stateunstableAlertingState.description:
- ALERTING_STATE_PASS: Monitor is not triggered.
 - ALERTING_STATE_PENDING: Monitor is triggered but not yet alerting.
 - ALERTING_STATE_ALERTING: Monitor is triggered and alerting.
 - ALERTING_STATE_MUTED: Monitor is triggered but is muted.

recipients.description:
Every recipient reachable from the monitor's notification policy at the
severity, using the policy's default routes and then every override route,
each listed once. Override label matchers are not applied. Empty when the
monitor has no notification policy.

stateunstableMonitorStatus.description: MonitorStatus contains the status of a monitor.

stateunstableSendTestNotificationRespons.description:
Returned when the test notification is accepted for delivery. Acceptance
does not confirm that any integration delivered it.

stateunstableTestNotificationRecipient.description:
A recipient of a monitor's notification policy: a notifier, or a
destination configured directly on the policy. A destination that sends to
several Slack channels or VictorOps routing keys is one recipient per
channel or routing key.

id.description:
Opaque, server-issued ID. Pass it back in SendTestNotification's
`recipient_ids`. Stays valid until the notification policy or the
recipient's notifier changes.

display_name.description: The notifier's name, or a generated name describing the destination.

preview_markdown.description:
Markdown preview of the notification this recipient would receive. Set
only with `include_previews`, and only for recipients the test alert is
routed to with these signal labels. Templates render against the signal
labels alone, and values that would come from the monitor's query are
placeholders. Empty when the preview fails to render.

Optional signal filters in PromQL matcher syntax, e.g. `service="foo"` or
`namespace=~"prod-.*"`. Semantically identical to signal_filters and
AND-ed with it; representable as a repeated query parameter on GET.
parameters.name: signal_filter_exprs

post.description:
Lists the recipients a saved monitor's notification policy reaches at a
severity, with a rendered preview of the notification each would receive.
Sends nothing. A read served by POST, because signal labels cannot be
expressed as query parameters. Rate limited per tenant. A rate limited
request returns 429.

parameters.description: The slug of the saved monitor.
parameters.name: monitor_slug

post.description:
Sends a test notification for a saved monitor through its notification
policy's integrations. Does not change monitor state or create an alert.
Fails when the monitor has no notification policy. Sends are rate
limited per tenant and per monitor, and requests that fail validation
count toward the limits. A rate limited request returns 429; wait and
retry.

parameters.description: The slug of the saved monitor.
parameters.name: monitor_slug
